transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I'm just... I guess I'm here because of some stuff with food. After a long shift at the garage, I just... end up eating a lot more than I meant to. Like, I'll get a whole fast-food meal, and then eat snacks, and then just whatever is left in the fridge. All at once.
How often do these episodes of eating a lot more than you meant to happen?

Um... I don't know. Most weeks, I guess. At least one night a week I'll end up doing that. And then... I just try to fix it, you know? Like, I'll make myself throw up, or take some laxatives. Or I'll just skip eating the next day, or go run for hours. It's... it's been happening like this for a few months now.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?

Yeah... I guess I am. It's kind of stupid, but... yeah. 

Like, even if my work pants are actually fitting looser, if I check the scale and it's up even just a single pound... I don't know. I just feel like I'm getting fat. And then I start worrying that I'm just gonna lose control of my whole body. So... yeah, I guess I do worry about it.
How often do you make yourself throw up after eating?

Um... I don't know exactly. Just... sometimes. If I eat way too much, I'll just go to the bathroom and do it. Or... or I'll take those laxatives. I just get scared of what all that food is gonna do to me, I guess. So I just have to get rid of it.
How many times a month would you say you have one of these episodes where you eat a lot more than you meant to?

Um... like I said earlier, it's most weeks. So... maybe four or five times a month? 

At least one night a week I'll eat like that, and then... you know, try to make up for it. By throwing up, or taking the laxatives, or just skipping meals or working out extra. It's just... it's been going on like that for several months now.
How many times a month do you make yourself throw up after eating?

Uh... I mean, kind of like I just said. It's most weeks. 

Out of those four or five times a month, I guess I throw up for some of them. Other times I just use the laxatives, or... or work out extra hard, or skip eating, like I mentioned. It's just... whatever I do to make up for it. And yeah, it's been a few months of this.
How often do you take laxatives after eating?

I... I don't really count them separate. Like I was just saying, it's... most weeks I have at least one night where I eat like that. And then I just have to try and make up for it somehow. 

So it might be the laxatives, or throwing up, or... or skipping meals, or just working out extra. I just do one of them. I don't know exactly how many times for each specific thing. It's just... it's been going on like that for several months now.

I don't know. Like I said, I don't really keep track of which one I do more. It just... depends on the day, I guess.
